name: contraction-routing-secondary-v1
trigger: Calibration confidences were [0.05, 0.11, 0.15, 0.15, 0.21, 0.22]. The primary fixed threshold grid has no feasible nonzero calibration routing under its 25% budget. No analyst choosing this amendment inspected calibration or held-out runtimes before freezing these rules.
preservation: Keep the primary design, code, decisions, timings and results unchanged. No new provider calls or benchmark measurements.
candidates: Never escalate, plus midpoint thresholds between consecutive distinct calibration confidence values. Escalate strictly below the threshold; ties stay together. Candidate generation uses calibration confidences only.
fit: Use calibration runtimes only. Same geometric-mean runtime objective as the primary router, treating improvements below 2% as ties. At most floor(0.25*Ncal) escalations. Prefer fewer escalations, then never, then lower threshold on objective ties.
evaluation: Evaluate the selected rule once on existing held-out timings. Keep all original controls, noise floors, two-layout direction requirements and both 25% routing budgets. Report the primary cascade separately.
interpretation: Exploratory secondary evidence prompted by calibration-confidence inspection, not success of the original preregistered routing experiment. Do not change the rule after inspecting outcomes.
